title: Structure-based molecular hybridization design and synthesis of Keap1-Nrf2 inhibitors for anti-inflammatory treatment.
authors: Qin, Xiuting; Hou, Ruilin; Qu, Zhuo; Yu, Jianqiang; Zhang, Wannian; Ma, Hao; Zhuang, Chunlin
one_liner_zh: 该文研究Keap1-Nrf2蛋白-蛋白相互作用抑制剂的分子杂交设计与合成，虽涉及分子对接，但对象为蛋白-蛋白互作而非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题TF-DNA互作研究无关。
abstract: The Kelch-like ECH-associated protein 1 (Keap1)-nuclear factor erythroid 2-related factor 2 (Nrf2) signaling pathway stands as a pivotal mechanism in defending against oxidative stress damage and related inflammation. Blocking the Keap1-Nrf2 protein-protein interaction (PPI) offers a promising therapeutic approach for treating diseases related to oxidative stress and inflammation. Our group previously reported NXPZ-2, a naphthalene sulfonamide derivative targeting Keap1, which effectively inhibits the Keap1-Nrf2 PPI, thereby releasing Nrf2 to exert its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects. In the present work, we employed a structure-based molecular hybridization strategy to design a series of novel naphthalene sulfonamides by combining NXPZ-2 with the Nrf2 activator dimethyl fumarate (DMF) or its analogues. Among these new derivatives, compound 1c, specifically (Z)-4-((4-(N-(2-amino-2-oxoethyl)-N-(4-((N-(2-amino-2-oxoethyl)-4-methoxyphenyl)sulfonamide)naphthalen-1-yl) sulfamoyl)phenyl)amino)-4-oxobut-2-enoic acid, exhibited the highest PPI inhibitory activity, with a K(D2) value of 0.119 muM. In an LPS-induced RAW264.7 cell model, this compound mitigated LPS-induced cellular damage, suppressed the expression of pro-inflammatory cytokine TNF-alpha and IL-6, and significantly elevated the intracellular GSH and SOD enzyme activities. Furthermore, in an LPS-induced acute lung injury (ALI) mouse model, the compound demonstrated a remarkable ability to alleviate oxidative damage and inflammation in the lungs. In conclusion, this novel naphthalene sulfonamide represents a promising drug candidate for Keap1-targeting therapy in ALI. Molecular docking analysis revealed that the amide and maleic acid groups of 1c facilitate strong interactions with the Kelch domain of Keap1, explaining the compound's preference for binding through hydrogen bonding and pi-pi stacking interactions.
abstract_zh: Kelch样ECH相关蛋白1（Keap1）-核因子E2相关因子2（Nrf2）信号通路是对抗氧化应激损伤及相关炎症的关键机制。阻断Keap1-Nrf2蛋白-蛋白相互作用（PPI）为治疗氧化应激和炎症相关疾病提供了一种有前景的治疗策略。我们课题组此前报道了NXPZ-2，一种靶向Keap1的萘磺酰胺衍生物，能有效抑制Keap1-Nrf2 PPI，从而释放Nrf2以发挥其抗炎和抗氧化作用。在本研究中，我们采用基于结构的分子杂交策略，将NXPZ-2与Nrf2激活剂富马酸二甲酯（DMF）或其类似物结合，设计了一系列新型萘磺酰胺化合物。在这些新衍生物中，化合物1c，即(Z)-4-((4-(N-(2-氨基-2-氧代乙基)-N-(4-((N-(2-氨基-2-氧代乙基)-4-甲氧基苯基)磺酰胺基)萘-1-基)氨磺酰基)苯基)氨基)-4-氧代丁-2-烯酸，表现出最高的PPI抑制活性，其K(D2)值为0.119 μM。在LPS诱导的RAW264.7细胞模型中，该化合物减轻了LPS诱导的细胞损伤，抑制了促炎细胞因子TNF-α和IL-6的表达，并显著提高了细胞内GSH和SOD酶活性。此外，在LPS诱导的急性肺损伤（ALI）小鼠模型中，该化合物表现出显著缓解肺部氧化损伤和炎症的能力。总之，这种新型萘磺酰胺化合物代表了ALI中靶向Keap1治疗的一种有前景的药物候选物。分子对接分析揭示，1c的酰胺和马来酸基团促进其与Keap1的Kelch结构域发生强相互作用，解释了该化合物通过氢键和π-π堆积相互作用优先结合的倾向。
